title: Local characterization of a groupoid stackification map
statement: Fix the universes of [def-weil-size-convention] and a small site $(\mathcal C,J)$ [def-weil-pbc-topos]. Represent categories fibred in groupoids and pullback-compatible functors by pseudofunctors and strong transformations, as in [lem-sfb-groupoid-stackification-local-description]. For $i:P\to A$, say that $i$ is a groupoid stackification map if $P$ and $A$ have groupoid fibres, $A$ is a $J$-stack, and the following three conditions hold: the presheaves of arrows between images of objects are the sheafifications of the original arrow presheaves, compatibly with the unit and pullback comparisons; every object of $A$ is locally isomorphic to an image of $i$ on a covering sieve; and every pullback-compatible functor from $P$ to any $J$-stack in groupoids extends across $i$ up to an invertible modification. These are exactly the three properties asserted by [lem-sfb-groupoid-stackification-local-description]; this predicate does not select a stackification.
